story_type: night medevac off a fishing boat plowing through swells, infrared and hoist camera
hook: 60 miles out, at night, a fisherman needed a helicopter.
narration: Sixty miles south of Nantucket, in the dark, a fisherman needed a helicopter.
His boat, the fishing vessel Capt. Bligh, kept plowing through the swells.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Cape Cod came in low, filming with a camera that sees heat, where warm things glow white.
From the door, the deck below was a blur of spray, rigging and moving water.
In the door, the flight mechanic watched the deck below and worked the hoist.
[short pause] Then the basket came back up out of the dark.
outcome: The Air Station Cape Cod crew medically evacuated the fisherman from the Capt. Bligh.
title: Night hoist 60 miles off Nantucket
description:
On Nov. 26, 2012, a Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station Cape Cod medically evacuated a fisherman from the fishing vessel Capt. Bligh about 60 miles south of Nantucket, Massachusetts.
